summary: 27/27 tests pass on host (pure control flow, no vllm import, no CUDA context). lint_fidelity passes with no BLOCKING. Beyond self-consistency, three grounding checks tie the package to real vLLM behavior: (1) implementation text diffed against pinned source at vllm/v1/worker/block_table.py, gpu_model_runner.py, flash_attn.py, attention.py, backend.py, worker/utils.py, forward_context.py — verbatim or dossier-approved subtractions at all cited anchors; (2) the HOST SEAM CPU mirror of _compute_slot_mapping_kernel was differential-tested against the implementation's verbatim Triton kernel run under TRITON_INTERPRET=1 — bit-identical slot_mapping output across 4 cases (2-req identity+PAD tail, CP interleave W=2/I=2 on both ranks, hybrid 32x16 split, empty-request qsl row); (3) the reshape_and_cache_flash host mirror was differential-tested against the real CUDA op inside the GPU container — identical writes (slot<0 skipped, slot//bs & slot%bs decomposition, K/V row copies) and the woosuk NOTE behavior (op uses slot_mapping's length, not key's, as token count) confirmed on real hardware. The seam pattern itself is sanctioned by real vLLM: vllm/utils/cpu_triton_utils.py monkey-patches the same kernel for the CPU backend.

grounding_notes: Production-path confirmation: pinned v0.27.1 gpu_input_batch.py:L31 imports MultiGroupBlockTable from vllm/v1/worker/block_table.py and constructs it at L186 — the chapter's main file is the InputBatch.block_table production source (the newer vllm/v1/worker/gpu/block_table.py BlockTables staged-writes variant is used by cudagraph_utils/pcp_manager/speculator paths, not the InputBatch main line).
